summary.interpretation: The 'known_correct' row is the FALSE-ALARM rate and the 'blind_spot' row is the DETECTION rate. The pre-registered p < 1e-6 co-inclusion rule is the one used for every verdict; the loose p99 rule is reported only to show what it costs.
